doc.text: Long-term data is at 25 C / 60% RH. This market needs 30 C / 65% RH. The pack says to ask rather than accept a commitment letter. Agree we ask?
Agree. Combine it with the shelf-life question so the company gets one letter.
Is the manufacturing site the same as in the reference approval?
Yes: Plant 2 on both. Only shelf life differs.
18 months at 30 C / 65% RH. Rule met with margin.
